get_air_quality_index.description: Get the hourly air quality index (LKI, from 1 for good to 11 for very bad) between two times, up to 7 days apart, of one station or every station, with each hour's level and the highest. Returns up to 100 a page.

mock_response.summary: Found 3 hourly readings at NL49012 from 2025-06-01T00:00:00Z to 2025-06-01T23:00:00Z, the highest 4 (Moderate).

get_component.description: Get a pollutant's description from Luchtmeetnet, where it comes from and its legal limit, and which concentrations give which air quality index from 1 (good) to 11 (very bad).

mock_response.description:
The highest concentrations of NO2 exist during the morning and evening rush hour. NOx is emitted when fuel is being burned e.g. in transport, industrial processes and power generation. NO2 is formed in a reaction between nitric oxide (NO) and ozone (O3). The weather and traffic influence the concentrations substantially. The yearly average limit value is 40 (μg/m3).

Displayed measured values are indicative and no rights can be derived from them, see disclaimer.
mock_response.name: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2)
mock_response.summary: Nitrogen dioxide (NO2): 11 index bands, in µg/m³.

description: Check the air in the Netherlands with Luchtmeetnet, the national air quality monitoring network: hourly measurements of nitrogen dioxide, ozone, particulate matter and more from about a hundred stations, the air quality index (LKI) from good to very bad, and a forecast for any spot, and run a workflow when a station's index reaches a level. No account or API key required.

luchtmeetnet_air_quality_index_reached_t.description: Triggers when a station's hourly air quality index (1 for good to 11 for very bad) rises to or past the level you choose. It triggers once on the way up, and again only after the index has dropped under the level. Air already at that level when you turn it on doesn't trigger it until it clears and comes back.
luchtmeetnet_air_quality_index_reached_t.display_name: Air quality index reached a level

parameters.description: The station to watch, picked by place or typed as its number, e.g. NL49012.
parameters.name: station

parameters.description: Trigger when the index reaches this level: Moderate (4 and up), Insufficient (7 and up), Bad (9 and up) or Very bad (11). Leave blank for Insufficient.
parameters.name: level
